The question asks for the movie starring Meryl Streep that was nominated for Best Picture the same year that Pioneer 11 visited Saturn. "The Deer Hunter" was nominated in 1979 for films released in 1978, whereas "Kramer vs. Kramer" was nominated in 1980 for films released in 1979—the year Pioneer 11 visited Saturn (September 1979).
